name: Ventia Services Group Limited
summary: Ventia Services Group Limited provides infrastructure services in Australia and New Zealand. It offers asset management services, such as asset condition analysis, strategy and planning, risk optimization, and systems and documentation; and digital solutions, including panorama property portal, drone solutions, remote electronic verification systems, automatic meter readings, Ventia operations centre, and telecommunication system integration services.
